'''Dareeyak Teleport''' is a spell in the [[Ancient Magicks]] spellbook, requiring a [[Magic]] level of 78 to cast. It teleports the caster to the [[Ruins (west)|ruins]] south of [[The Forgotten Cemetery]] in level 23 [[Wilderness]]. It can be useful for easy access to the [[Crazy archaeologist]], or to the [[Chaos Temple (church)|chaos temple]] for Prayer training.

As with all Ancient Magicks spells, the quest [[Desert Treasure I]] must be completed to cast this spell.
